hints.title: Circular Keyboard Distance
hints.text: The pointer can move clockwise or counter-clockwise between any two characters on the 26-letter wheel.

hints.title: Shortest Circular Step Calculation
hints.text: The shortest distance between character c1 and c2 is min(abs(c1 - c2), 26 - abs(c1 - c2)).

hints.title: Adding Keystroke Time
hints.text: Add 1 second for typing each character, tracking pointer position starting at "a".

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def minTimeToType(self, word: str) -> int:
        curr = "a"
        ans = 0
        for c in word:
            diff = abs(ord(c) - ord(curr))
            ans += min(diff, 26 - diff) + 1
            curr = c
        return ans
```

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Full rotational simulation is redundant when modulo arithmetic computes distance in O(1).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constant space accumulator running in linear time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should compute min(diff, 26 - diff) cleanly.
